column1: # A 3D game: right stick for the camera, the D-pad for the field map. main reads no touch screen, mouse or keyboard
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): no virtual address memory; nninitStartup sets a heap of 3.14 GB. The DX's 4 GB layout (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB
# The Switch version runs at 30 fps: the game asks for present interval 2 (1 on the logos and the title) and nothing else limits it, and its logic steps by the time that passed
# (the tutorial battle's AP bar fills at the same wall-clock rate at 30 and at 60 fps: 11 AP a minute in both Mac runs). So present_interval display (frames follow the display tick,
# the player's Frame rate row sets 30 or 60 through the present interval alone) is all it takes. Mac, M4 Pro, headless, 60 fps over the opening dialogue and the prologue battle
# (five runs of 8 to 10 minutes): frame time p50 16.66 ms, p95 16.9 ms, GPU p50 6.5 to 9.6 ms (battle about 9 to 9.6), GPU p95 about 11 ms; at 30 fps over the same opening: GPU p50 8.7 ms.
# In the field (the start of Kurken Island, from the autosave, one run): frame p50 16.6-16.9 ms, GPU p50 6.9-8.0 ms. Some runs overlapped other work on the Mac, so the GPU times
# are contended. Mac numbers, not phone numbers
